style: Lautum brand system. STRICTLY GRAYSCALE — pure black and near-white with mid-greys for depth only; absolutely no color, no hue, ever. The aesthetic of a modern AI-infrastructure company (OpenAI, Anthropic, Linear, X): crisp, flat, digital, vector-clean, architectural, premium. LINEWORK: precise, thin, even-weight geometric strokes; sharp corners; CAD-like mathematical accuracy. COMPOSITION: calm and minimal with generous negative space; one single clear subject; balanced, never busy, never cluttered. MOTIFS, used sparingly and deliberately (never as clutter): (1) large translucent rectangular planes stacked in receding depth — a control plane; (2) a SPARSE graph of a few small circular nodes joined by thin straight edges — an evidence graph. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: any color; texture, grain, noise, film, paper, halftone; decorative gradients; glow, bokeh, lens blur; 3D-render shininess; heavy drop shadows (one faint flat shadow is the most allowed); photographic realism; dense or chaotic line tangles; logos, watermarks, UI chrome; and any unintended text.
voice: Precise, sober, technical, and confident. Audience: engineers, CISOs, and risk leaders at regulated enterprises. No hype, no buzzwords, no 'effortless compliance', no 'AI-powered AI governance'. Every claim is backed by a concrete mechanism. Sentences are declarative and specific. The core idea: governance is generated as a byproduct of building and running AI — not assembled by hand. Lautum is a control plane, not documentation.
